Package com.nis1.thesis.sdk

Class MitigationParameters

java.lang.Object
com.nis1.thesis.sdk.MitigationParameters
public class MitigationParameters extends Object
Typed replacement for MitigationCommandData's previous raw-String additionalParameters field. Fields mirror exactly what SdkModuleHost.parseMitigationCommand populates and what OpenDaylightModule.onMitigationCommand/onRemoveMitigation actually read - see SDK_USABILITY_AUDIT.md, Role Expressiveness dimension, for why an opaque JSON string was a problem: a reader could not tell what shape/fields to expect without reading the receiving module's parser.

telemetry and lifecycle stay loosely typed (Map<String,Object>) since their fields grow independently over time (e.g. new telemetry keys added by StageTimer-style instrumentation) - forcing a rigid schema on those would just reintroduce a different version of the same problem.
